desc:
Build your kingdom from a single farm to a golden empire.

💰 Work businesses to earn coins and level up
💵 Invest in properties that pay you money passively
🤝 Find your companions and equip them with weapons and armor
🔫 Attack other players and steal their coins
🫡 Raise your Army of thousands and fight for control
🏆 Earn trophies and climb the leaderboards
